# FinOps Studio — 12 Deterministic Banking, Payroll, Treasury & E-Invoicing Cloud APIs & Official MCP Suite

> Zero-hallucination financial file generators, checksum validators, and parsers for CFOs, accounting firms, ERP integrators, n8n/Make workflows, and AI agents (Model Context Protocol / MCP). Hosted on Apify Cloud (`https://apify.com/finops_studio`) with interactive previews and documentation at `https://geornaden.github.io/finops-studio/`.

## Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) Registry Identifiers (`registry.modelcontextprotocol.io`)
- Unified Suite: `io.github.Geornaden/finops-studio` (`https://mcp.apify.com/?actors=finops_studio/sepa-xml-generator,finops_studio/eu-einvoice-xml-generator,finops_studio/nacha-ach-file-generator,finops_studio/bai2-bank-statement-parser,finops_studio/datev-buchungsstapel-generator`)
- Dedicated Single-Tool MCP Servers:
  - `io.github.Geornaden/sepa-xml-pain001-iban-mcp`
  - `io.github.Geornaden/peppol-xrechnung-facturx-einvoice-mcp`
  - `io.github.Geornaden/nacha-ach-payroll-generator-mcp`
  - `io.github.Geornaden/bai2-bank-statement-parser-mcp`
  - `io.github.Geornaden/datev-buchungsstapel-extf-mcp`

## 12 Production API & Store Tools (`finops_studio`)

1. [SEPA XML Generator & IBAN Validator (`pain.001` & `pain.008`)](https://apify.com/finops_studio/sepa-xml-generator): Converts CSV/Excel/JSON into 2026 EPC structured-address ISO 20022 `pain.001.001.09` / `pain.001.001.03` Credit Transfers and `pain.008.001.08` / `pain.008.001.02` Direct Debits with ISO 13616 MOD-97 IBAN verification and integer-cent `CtrlSum`. ($0/mo + $0.02/tx)
   - Docs: https://geornaden.github.io/finops-studio/sepa-xml-generator.html

2. [EU E-Invoice XML Generator (`Peppol BIS 3.0`, `XRechnung 3.0` & `Factur-X / ZUGFeRD`)](https://apify.com/finops_studio/eu-einvoice-xml-generator): Generates mandatory 2026 EN 16931 European B2B/B2G e-invoices in OASIS UBL 2.1 and UN/CEFACT CII with cent-exact VAT summation. ($0/mo + $0.05/invoice)
   - Docs: https://geornaden.github.io/finops-studio/eu-einvoice-xml-generator.html

3. [US NACHA ACH File Generator, ABA Routing Validator & Parser (`PPD`, `CCD`, `WEB`)](https://apify.com/finops_studio/nacha-ach-file-generator): Generates strict 94-character block-10 padded US `.ach` bank files for payroll direct deposit and vendor payouts with 10-point ABA routing checksums. ($0/mo + $0.02/entry)
   - Docs: https://geornaden.github.io/finops-studio/nacha-ach-file-generator.html

4. [Corporate `BAI2` Bank Statement Parser to JSON & CSV](https://apify.com/finops_studio/bai2-bank-statement-parser): Parses Bank Administration Institute (`BAI2`) corporate treasury statements (`01/02/03/16/88/49/98/99`) from J.P. Morgan, BofA CashPro, Wells Fargo CEO, CitiDirect, and HSBCnet into JSON and CSV. ($0/mo + $0.02/tx)
   - Docs: https://geornaden.github.io/finops-studio/bai2-bank-statement-parser.html

5. [German `DATEV Buchungsstapel` EXTF v700 CSV Generator (`SKR03` & `SKR04`)](https://apify.com/finops_studio/datev-buchungsstapel-generator): Converts Stripe payouts, Shopify orders, or invoice JSON/CSV into official DATEV EXTF v700 semicolon `Buchungsstapel` files. ($0/mo + $0.02/booking)
   - Docs: https://geornaden.github.io/finops-studio/datev-buchungsstapel-generator.html

6. [Australian `ABA` Direct Entry Bank File Generator (BECS / Cemtex)](https://apify.com/finops_studio/aba-cemtex-file-generator): Generates strict 120-character Australian `.aba` bulk payroll & supplier files for CBA CommBiz, NAB Connect, Westpac Live, and ANZ. ($0/mo + $0.02/row)
   - Docs: https://geornaden.github.io/finops-studio/aba-cemtex-file-generator.html

7. [ISO 20022 `pain.002` Bank Payment Status & Rejection Code Decoder](https://apify.com/finops_studio/iso20022-pain002-status-parser): Decodes `pain.002.001.03` & `pain.002.001.10` XML bank status files and 40+ ISO rejection codes (`AC04`, `AM04`, `BE04`, `MD01`) into plain-English fixes. ($0/mo + $0.02/tx)
   - Docs: https://geornaden.github.io/finops-studio/iso20022-pain002-decoder.html

8. [UK `BACS Standard 18` (100-Character) GBP Direct Credit & Debit File Generator](https://apify.com/finops_studio/uk-bacs-standard18-generator): Generates exact 100-character UK BACS files (`VOL1`/`HDR1`/`UHL1`/Detail/Contra/`UTL1`) for Barclays, HSBC, Lloyds, and NatWest. ($0/mo + $0.02/row)
   - Docs: https://geornaden.github.io/finops-studio/uk-bacs-standard-18-file-generator.html

9. [Canadian `CPA-005` (1464-Byte) EFT Direct Deposit File Generator](https://apify.com/finops_studio/canada-cpa005-eft-generator): Generates strict 1464-character Payments Canada Standard 005 EFT payroll & supplier files (`A`/`C`/`Z` records) for RBC, TD, BMO, and Scotiabank. ($0/mo + $0.02/segment)
   - Docs: https://geornaden.github.io/finops-studio/canada-cpa-005-eft-file-generator.html

10. [US Bank Payee Positive Pay Check Fraud File Generator (Chase, BofA CashPro, Wells Fargo CEO, PNC)](https://apify.com/finops_studio/us-positive-pay-check-generator): Generates exact 80-character fixed-width and CSV Payee Positive Pay check-issue/void files from QuickBooks, NetSuite, Xero, or CSV check registers. ($0/mo + $0.02/check)
    - Docs: https://geornaden.github.io/finops-studio/us-positive-pay-check-file-generator-chase-bofa-wells-fargo.html

11. [Spanish AEB Norma 43 (`Cuaderno 43`) Corporate Bank Statement Parser to JSON & CSV](https://apify.com/finops_studio/spanish-aeb-norma43-parser): Parses 80-character Spanish `.n43` / `.c43` corporate bank statements (CaixaBank, BBVA, Santander, Sabadell, Bankinter) into JSON & UTF-8 CSV with automatic Bank of Spain MOD-11 `DC` + ISO 13616 `ES` IBAN calculation and cent-exact Record `33` balance audit. ($0/mo + $0.02/tx)
    - Docs: https://geornaden.github.io/finops-studio/spanish-aeb-norma-43-cuaderno-43-bank-statement-parser.html

12. [ISO 20022 `pacs.008.001.08` Fedwire Funds & SWIFT CBPR+ Wire Transfer XML Generator](https://apify.com/finops_studio/iso20022-pacs008-fedwire-generator): Generates compliant `head.001.001.02` + `pacs.008.001.08` wire transfer XML for Federal Reserve Fedwire Funds (`FDW` / `USABA`), SWIFT CBPR+, UK CHAPS, and Eurosystem TARGET2 with UUID v4 `UETR`, ABA MOD-10 verification, and 2026 structured addresses. ($0/mo + $0.02/wire)
    - Docs: https://geornaden.github.io/finops-studio/fedwire-iso20022-pacs008-swift-cbpr-xml-generator.html
